_meta.description: Post-Phase-9.1 baseline. Gate tests: T6 x 32B/72B, W1/W2 x 32B, T1/T5 canaries, B2 x 32B/72B regression status.

T6_32b.note: Post-09.1 typical: 4 steps (read x3 + final). Gate fails if >5.

T6_72b.note: Post-09.1 typical: 4 steps. Gate fails if >5. (Live observed 4, not 5 as in research defaults.)

W1_32b.note: Loop-injection enforces 3 steps: read+edit+final. >3 = regression in 09.1-05 fix.

W2_32b.note: Same as W1: directive wording + loop injection holds 3 steps.

T1_32b.note: Canary. 1 step typical; 3 steps observed once (model variance, 09.1-03). 4+ = alarm.

B2_32b.note: KNOWN regression since v1.2 prompt growth. PERF-03 (Phase 11) target. Gate must NOT fail on this until PERF-03 lands.

B2_72b.note: KNOWN regression since v1.2 prompt growth. PERF-03 (Phase 11) target. Gate must NOT fail on this until PERF-03 lands.
